ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit provision: up to six months of transition assistance at your then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion afterwards. The Agreement currently has no data-return or exit-assistance obligation (Section 16.5 defers Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15, neither of which addresses return or deletion), and we cannot migrate off a hosted service without it. If six months is too long, we can accept ninety days of assistance.
input.summary: Insert Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, machine-readable data return within 30 days, and certified deletion.
